title: Zuma Game
description: Remove balls from the board by inserting balls from hand to form sequences of 3 or more.
pseudocode:
1. function findMinStep(board, hand):
2.   if board is empty: return 0
3.   for i in range(len(board)):
4.     for j in range(len(hand)):
5.       if can_insert(hand[j], board[i]):
6.         newBoard = remove_matches(board + hand[j])
7.         res = findMinStep(newBoard, hand - hand[j])
8.         min_steps = min(min_steps, 1 + res)
